title: Block Ticket
tagline: Revolutionizing event management and decentralized ticketing with NFTs
description: With the power of transparency and proof of ownership of NFTs, I attempted to make a ticketing and event management system. I deployed the smart contracts on polygon and used moralis for most of the web3 functionalities. I stored assets on IPFS and used NFT.storage for minting.With the power of transparency and proof of ownership of NFTs, I attempted to make a ticketing and event management system.
